notes: Ten Daraja result/error codes for M-PESA Express (STK Push). Not covered by any corpus document and therefore not asserted: a timeout result code, an 'insufficient funds' result code, and reversal-specific callback codes. Do not infer them from the Nigerian NIP code set.

sources.name: Safaricom Daraja developer portal, M-Pesa Express (STK Push) Simulate API reference

entries.subject: result_code_success
entries.notes: 0 means success in both the sync acknowledgement and the async callback.

entries.subject: result_code_cancelled_by_user
entries.notes: The customer dismissed the STK prompt or let it time out; no funds move.

entries.subject: error_invalid_shortcode
entries.notes: Causes: wrong Content-Type, wrong parameter name, or invalid/missing BusinessShortCode. The table row reads '| 400.002.02 | Bad Request - Invalid XXXX. | Ensure the request payload is set as per API documentation. | 400 |'. enum_match set: {400.002.02}.

entries.subject: error_invalid_access_token
entries.quote: 404.001.03 | Invalid Access Token | Regenerate a new access token and use it before one hour expiry period.
entries.notes: Tokens expire hourly; regenerate with the correct consumer key and secret. enum_match set: {404.001.03}.

entries.subject: error_resource_not_found
entries.quote: 404.001.01 | Resource not found | Make sure you are calling the correct API endpoint.

entries.subject: error_method_not_allowed
entries.quote: 405.001 | Method Not Allowed (e.g. GET Method Not Allowed) | Ensure you're passing the request as POST. Any other method will be rejected.
entries.notes: STK Push is POST only. enum_match set: {405.001}.

entries.subject: error_merchant_does_not_exist
entries.quote: 500.001.1001 | Merchant does not exist | Ensure you're using the short code used on Go Live as BusinessShortCode parameter value in the request.
entries.notes: The same code string is reused for several distinct 500.001.1001 meanings; the errorMessage disambiguates. enum_match set: {500.001.1001}.

entries.subject: error_wrong_credentials
entries.display: 500.001.1001 Wrong credentials - password does not match shortcode/timestamp
entries.quote: 500.001.1001 | Wrong credentials | This error can be caused by:- The Password parameter provided in the request is either invalid or missing.
entries.notes: Password is base64(Shortcode+Passkey+Timestamp); all three must match the request body. enum_match set: {500.001.1001}.

entries.subject: error_system_busy
entries.display: 500.003.02 System is busy - retry after a short wait
entries.quote: 500.003.02 | System is busy. Please try again in few minutes. | Retry the request after a short wait.
entries.notes: Same code is also used for 'Error Occurred: Spike Arrest Violation'; only the message distinguishes them. enum_match set: {500.003.02}.

entries.subject: error_quota_violation
entries.display: 500.003.03 Quota Violation - API request limit exceeded
entries.quote: 500.003.03 | Quota Violation | You are sending multiple requests that violate the API request limit.
entries.notes: Distinct from 500.003.02 spike arrest (per-second limit) vs quota (period request limit). enum_match set: {500.003.03}.
